newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's KGHM assumes '97 copper price at $2,200 T.
newsitem.headline: Poland's KGHM assumes '97 copper price at $2,200 T.

text.p: Poland's KGHM copper concern, which is due to start trading in London and Warsaw on July 10, expects the copper price to average $2,200 per tonne this year on the London Metal Exchange, the firm said in its issue prospectus.

It said it expected the silver price to average $170 per kg this year. The average annual price assumptions were published as the basis for the firm's net earnings forecast at 286 million zlotys for 1997 against 147 million zlotys in 1996.
KGHM said the average copper price in the first quarter of this year was $2,421 per tonne and the average price of silver at $161 per kg. --Jan Strupczewski +48 22 653 9700
